Oracle Fusion 26D features on by default: all 173, by module

These 173 features need no action to enable, per Oracle's 26D What's New documents, so your users can meet them as soon as 26D reaches your environment. By area: 6 in Financials, 14 in Procurement, 60 in Supply Chain & Manufacturing, 3 in Logistics (OTM, GTM, WMS), 1 in Project Management and 89 in HCM. Oracle rates 18 of them "Larger scale".

Every row comes from the Feature Summary tables in Oracle's 26D What's New documents, with Oracle's own "Impact to Existing Processes" and "Action to Enable" columns as Oracle states them. Each title links to Oracle's feature page. Oracle can revise its documents; we recheck them every week. Always confirm on the linked Oracle page.

Oracle sources: Financials 26D What's New · Project Management 26D What's New · Risk Management (Classic) 26D What's New · Risk Management (Redwood) 26D What's New · Self Service Financials 26D What's New · Absence Management 26D What's New · Benefits 26D What's New · Compensation 26D What's New · Human Resources 26D What's New · Learning and Development 26D What's New · Payroll 26D What's New · Recruiting 26D What's New · Talent Management 26D What's New · Time and Labor 26D What's New · Workforce Scheduling 26D What's New · Warehouse Management 26D What's New · Demand Management 26D What's New · Inventory Management 26D What's New · Maintenance 26D What's New · Manufacturing 26D What's New · Order Management 26D What's New · Product Lifecycle Management 26D What's New · Procurement 26D What's New · Supply Chain Collaboration 26D What's New · Supply Planning 26D What's New · Sales and Operations Planning 26D What's New · Self Service Procurement 26D What's New

Frequently asked questions

Which 26D features switch on without any action?

173 features in Oracle's 26D What's New documents for the modules we cover have "None" in Oracle's Action to Enable column: 6 in Financials, 14 in Procurement, 60 in Supply Chain & Manufacturing, 3 in Logistics (OTM, GTM, WMS), 1 in Project Management and 89 in HCM.

Which 26D on-by-default changes are the biggest?

Oracle rates 18 of them "Larger scale" in its Impact to Existing Processes column. They are marked in the tables below, and they are the first ones to test.

Can I switch these features off?

Oracle's feature page for each one says whether there is anything to configure or turn off. This page only repeats Oracle's Action to Enable column.
